name: docs
text:
Dogecoin explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Dogecoin address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Dogecoin targets one block per minute, uses per-block DigiShield difficulty adjustment and supports Scrypt merged mining through AuxPoW. Since block 600,000 the block subsidy is 10,000 DOGE, with no further halvings.

1 DOGE = 100,000,000 koinu. Fee rates use koinu/B. Fiat values use the provider's Dogecoin prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

The explorer shows public Dogecoin transactions. Historical mining series and complete address indexing are not currently verified. Provider rate limits are separate from missing indexing capability.

The pending view reflects a node’s mempool; different nodes may see different transactions. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Successful retained responses carry X-DOGE-Observed-At and X-DOGE-Stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

GET /api/blocks/tip/height
GET /api/block-height/100000
GET /api/block/100000/txs
GET /api/tx/19220173c151925d493a25dbe67798fa11e6e4db01b927b1c04cddead85d3d12
GET /api/address/DDogepartyxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxw1dfzr/txs
GET /api/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid

Live updates: WebSocket /api/v1/ws with action init, followed by action want and data [blocks, stats, mempool-blocks].
